q25115.en: Air pollution from vehicles increases if the injectors are faulty.

explain.short: Faulty injectors (iniettori, the parts that spray fuel into the engine) spray fuel badly. The fuel does not burn well, so more harmful gas comes out.
explain.rule: Vehicles pollute the air mainly with exhaust gases (gas di scarico) from burning fuel in the engine. A badly working engine (faulty injectors, dark or heavy smoke) pollutes more.
explain.trap: No trap: 'difettosi' (faulty) means a worse engine, so more pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Faulty injectors = more pollution
lines: Injectors spray fuel into the engine

q25116.en: More smoke from the exhaust is a sign of more pollution caused by the engine.

explain.short: Smoke from the exhaust (scarico) shows unburnt fuel and particles. More smoke means the engine is polluting more.
explain.rule: Vehicles pollute the air mainly with exhaust gases (gas di scarico) from burning fuel in the engine. A badly working engine (faulty injectors, dark or heavy smoke) pollutes more.
explain.trap: 'sintomo' means sign: more smoke is a warning sign, not something normal.

sceneParams.caption: More exhaust smoke = more pollution
lines: Lots of smoke from the exhaust
Sign of a badly working engine

q25117.en: Air pollution from vehicles is greater if the exhaust smoke is dark.

explain.short: Dark smoke means fuel is not burning completely. It carries soot and harmful gas, so it pollutes more.
explain.rule: Vehicles pollute the air mainly with exhaust gases (gas di scarico) from burning fuel in the engine. A badly working engine (faulty injectors, dark or heavy smoke) pollutes more.
explain.trap: 'colore scuro' (dark colour) is the warning sign of bad burning.

sceneParams.caption: Dark exhaust smoke = more pollution

q25118.en: Air pollution from vehicles can cause damage to the airways and eye irritation.

explain.short: Exhaust gases are harmful to health. Breathing them can damage the airways (vie respiratorie, nose, throat and lungs) and irritate the eyes.
explain.rule: Vehicle pollution harms people (airways, eyes) and the planet (smog, acid rain, greenhouse effect).
explain.trap: 'può causare' (can cause): a possible effect, and it is true.

sceneParams.caption: Exhaust gas harms lungs and eyes

q25119.en: Air pollution from vehicles increases smog, acid rain and the greenhouse effect.

explain.short: Exhaust gases make smog (dirty air over cities), acid rain and the greenhouse effect (effetto serra, the planet getting warmer) worse.
explain.rule: Vehicle pollution harms people (airways, eyes) and the planet (smog, acid rain, greenhouse effect).
explain.trap: No trap: all three effects listed are real effects of exhaust gases.

sceneParams.caption: Exhaust gas: smog, acid rain, warming

q25120.en: Air pollution from vehicles is mostly due to exhaust gases, produced by combustion inside the engine.

explain.short: The engine burns fuel, and the burning (combustione) produces exhaust gases. These gases are the main source of vehicle air pollution.
explain.rule: Vehicles pollute the air mainly with exhaust gases (gas di scarico) from burning fuel in the engine. A badly working engine (faulty injectors, dark or heavy smoke) pollutes more.
explain.trap: 'per la maggior parte' (mostly): yes, exhaust gases are the main cause.

sceneParams.caption: Main cause: exhaust gases from the engine

q25121.en: Air pollution produced by vehicles depends mainly on the humidity in the air.

explain.short: Vehicle pollution comes mainly from exhaust gases made by the engine. Humidity (umidità, water in the air) is not the cause.
explain.rule: Vehicles pollute the air mainly with exhaust gases (gas di scarico) from burning fuel in the engine. A badly working engine (faulty injectors, dark or heavy smoke) pollutes more.
explain.trap: 'umidità' (humidity) is the wrong cause: the real one is the exhaust gas.

sceneParams.caption: Pollution comes from exhaust, not humidity

q25122.en: Air pollution from motor vehicles can decrease if you reduce the weight of the vehicle.

explain.short: A heavier car needs more fuel to move. Taking out useless weight saves fuel, so it pollutes less.
explain.rule: You pollute less with a lighter car, clean fuels (electric, methane, LPG), the engine off during long stops and fewer short trips. You pollute more with a roof load, always using low gears, or revving the engine in neutral or with the clutch pressed.
explain.trap: 'alleggerisce' means you make it lighter: less weight, less fuel, less pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Lighter car = less fuel, less pollution

q25123.en: Air pollution from motor vehicles can be reduced by choosing vehicles powered by electricity, methane or LPG.

explain.short: Electric cars give no exhaust gas while driving. Methane and LPG (GPL, liquid gas) burn more cleanly than petrol or diesel.
explain.rule: You pollute less with a lighter car, clean fuels (electric, methane, LPG), the engine off during long stops and fewer short trips. You pollute more with a roof load, always using low gears, or revving the engine in neutral or with the clutch pressed.
explain.trap: No trap: these are the cleaner types of power (alimentazione).

sceneParams.caption: Electric, methane, LPG: cleaner

q25124.en: Air pollution from motor vehicles can decrease if you switch off the engine during a long stop.

explain.short: An engine running while the car is still burns fuel for nothing. Switching it off during a long stop (arresto prolungato) cuts pollution.
explain.rule: You pollute less with a lighter car, clean fuels (electric, methane, LPG), the engine off during long stops and fewer short trips. You pollute more with a roof load, always using low gears, or revving the engine in neutral or with the clutch pressed.
explain.trap: 'prolungato' (long): for a long stop, switching off is right.

sceneParams.caption: Long stop: switch off the engine
lines: Long stop, e.g. in a queue
Engine on: fuel burnt for nothing

q25125.en: Air pollution from motor vehicles can be reduced by avoiding using the vehicle for short trips.

explain.short: On short trips the engine stays cold, and a cold engine burns fuel badly and pollutes more. Walking or cycling is cleaner.
explain.rule: You pollute less with a lighter car, clean fuels (electric, methane, LPG), the engine off during long stops and fewer short trips. You pollute more with a roof load, always using low gears, or revving the engine in neutral or with the clutch pressed.
explain.trap: 'brevi percorsi' (short trips): the engine never warms up, so they pollute a lot.

sceneParams.caption: Avoid short trips: cold engine pollutes

q25126.en: If you drive a vehicle that emits too many polluting exhaust gases, you can be punished with a fine and the withdrawal of the registration document.

explain.short: Vehicles must respect the emission limits. A vehicle that pollutes too much breaks the law: fine and the registration document (carta di circolazione) can be taken away.
explain.rule: You pollute less with a lighter car, clean fuels (electric, methane, LPG), the engine off during long stops and fewer short trips. You pollute more with a roof load, always using low gears, or revving the engine in neutral or with the clutch pressed.
explain.trap: 'sanzione amministrativa' is a fine; 'ritiro' means it is taken away until the vehicle is fixed and checked.

sceneParams.caption: Too much exhaust gas: fine + document taken

q25127.en: Air pollution from motor vehicles can decrease if you put the luggage on the roof of the car.

explain.short: Luggage on the roof makes the car push more air (more air resistance). The engine needs more fuel, so it pollutes MORE.
explain.rule: You pollute less with a lighter car, clean fuels (electric, methane, LPG), the engine off during long stops and fewer short trips. You pollute more with a roof load, always using low gears, or revving the engine in neutral or with the clutch pressed.
explain.trap: 'sul tetto' (on the roof): it sounds harmless, but it increases fuel use and pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Roof luggage = more fuel, more pollution

q25128.en: Air pollution from motor vehicles can decrease if you always drive in low gears.

explain.short: In a low gear the engine turns very fast and burns more fuel. Driving always in low gears increases pollution.
explain.rule: You pollute less with a lighter car, clean fuels (electric, methane, LPG), the engine off during long stops and fewer short trips. You pollute more with a roof load, always using low gears, or revving the engine in neutral or with the clutch pressed.
explain.trap: 'sempre con marce basse' (always in low gears): high revs, more fuel, more pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Always low gears = more fuel
lines: High revs: more fuel and gas

q25129.en: Air pollution from motor vehicles can decrease if you press the accelerator while holding down the clutch pedal.

explain.short: With the clutch (frizione) pressed, the engine is not connected to the wheels. Pressing the accelerator only burns fuel for nothing and pollutes.
explain.rule: You pollute less with a lighter car, clean fuels (electric, methane, LPG), the engine off during long stops and fewer short trips. You pollute more with a roof load, always using low gears, or revving the engine in neutral or with the clutch pressed.
explain.trap: 'tenendo premuto il pedale della frizione' (holding the clutch down): revving goes nowhere.

sceneParams.caption: Revving with clutch down wastes fuel

keywords.it: tenendo premuto il pedale della frizione

q25130.en: Air pollution from motor vehicles can decrease if you press the accelerator with the gearbox in neutral.

explain.short: In neutral (folle) the engine does not move the car. Pressing the accelerator only burns fuel and makes exhaust gas for nothing.
explain.rule: You pollute less with a lighter car, clean fuels (electric, methane, LPG), the engine off during long stops and fewer short trips. You pollute more with a roof load, always using low gears, or revving the engine in neutral or with the clutch pressed.
explain.trap: 'in folle' (in neutral): revving the engine in neutral is pure waste.

sceneParams.caption: Revving in neutral wastes fuel

q25131.en: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, the air filter must be replaced periodically.

explain.short: The engine needs clean air to burn fuel well. A dirty air filter (filtro dell'aria) lets in too little air, so the fuel burns badly and pollutes.
explain.rule: To pollute less: replace the air filter regularly, have the diesel fuel system (pump and injectors) checked, have the engine checked if the smoke is too dark, and drive smoothly. Wrong: a throttle blip before changing gear, maximum revs, the pollen filter, the oil filter every season.
explain.trap: 'periodicamente' (regularly): yes, it is normal servicing.

sceneParams.caption: Change the air filter regularly

q25132.en: To reduce air pollution caused by diesel vehicles, the fuel system (injection pump and injectors) must be checked periodically.

explain.short: In a diesel engine the injection pump and injectors spray the fuel. If they work badly the fuel burns badly and makes dark smoke.
explain.rule: To pollute less: replace the air filter regularly, have the diesel fuel system (pump and injectors) checked, have the engine checked if the smoke is too dark, and drive smoothly. Wrong: a throttle blip before changing gear, maximum revs, the pollen filter, the oil filter every season.
explain.trap: No trap: 'sistema di alimentazione' (fuel system) is a real part to check.

sceneParams.caption: Diesel: check pump and injectors

q25133.en: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must have the engine checked if the exhaust smoke is too dark.

explain.short: Too dark smoke is a sign that the engine burns fuel badly. A mechanic must check it.
explain.rule: To pollute less: replace the air filter regularly, have the diesel fuel system (pump and injectors) checked, have the engine checked if the smoke is too dark, and drive smoothly. Wrong: a throttle blip before changing gear, maximum revs, the pollen filter, the oil filter every season.
explain.trap: 'troppo scuro' (too dark): this is the warning sign to act on.

sceneParams.caption: Smoke too dark: get the engine checked

q25134.en: To reduce air pollution, you must not accelerate and brake often while driving.

explain.short: Each strong acceleration burns extra fuel, and braking throws that energy away. Smooth driving that looks ahead pollutes less.
explain.rule: To pollute less: replace the air filter regularly, have the diesel fuel system (pump and injectors) checked, have the engine checked if the smoke is too dark, and drive smoothly. Wrong: a throttle blip before changing gear, maximum revs, the pollen filter, the oil filter every season.
explain.trap: 'non bisogna' with 'spesso' (often): avoiding frequent speeding up and braking is right.

sceneParams.caption: Smooth driving: less fuel, less smog

q25135.en: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must give a short press on the accelerator before pressing the clutch to change gear.

explain.short: A throttle blip before changing gear only burns extra fuel. It does not help, so it increases pollution.
explain.rule: To pollute less: replace the air filter regularly, have the diesel fuel system (pump and injectors) checked, have the engine checked if the smoke is too dark, and drive smoothly. Wrong: a throttle blip before changing gear, maximum revs, the pollen filter, the oil filter every season.
explain.trap: 'breve colpo di acceleratore' (short throttle blip): an old habit that only wastes fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Throttle blip before changing gear: waste
lines: Blip of throttle before gear change

q25136.en: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must use the engine at the maximum number of revs.

explain.short: At maximum revs (giri, engine turns per minute) the engine burns the most fuel. It pollutes more and makes more noise.
explain.rule: To pollute less: replace the air filter regularly, have the diesel fuel system (pump and injectors) checked, have the engine checked if the smoke is too dark, and drive smoothly. Wrong: a throttle blip before changing gear, maximum revs, the pollen filter, the oil filter every season.
explain.trap: 'al massimo numero di giri' (maximum revs): the opposite of eco driving.

sceneParams.caption: Max revs = max fuel and pollution
lines: Most fuel, most gas, most noise

q25137.en: To reduce air pollution caused by the vehicle's exhaust gases, you must replace the pollen filter periodically.

explain.short: The pollen filter (filtro antipolline) only cleans the air that comes into the passenger area. It has nothing to do with the exhaust gases.
explain.rule: To pollute less: replace the air filter regularly, have the diesel fuel system (pump and injectors) checked, have the engine checked if the smoke is too dark, and drive smoothly. Wrong: a throttle blip before changing gear, maximum revs, the pollen filter, the oil filter every season.
explain.trap: 'filtro antipolline' (pollen filter) is for the cabin air, not for the engine.

sceneParams.caption: Pollen filter cleans cabin air, not exhaust
lines: It does not touch the engine

q25138.en: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must replace the oil filter at every change of season.

explain.short: The oil filter is changed with the oil, following the maker's service plan (by distance or time). Changing it every season is not the rule.
explain.rule: To pollute less: replace the air filter regularly, have the diesel fuel system (pump and injectors) checked, have the engine checked if the smoke is too dark, and drive smoothly. Wrong: a throttle blip before changing gear, maximum revs, the pollen filter, the oil filter every season.
explain.trap: 'ad ogni cambio di stagione' (every change of season): a made-up schedule.

sceneParams.caption: Oil filter: follow the service plan
lines: Oil filter changed with the oil

q25139.en: To save fuel and protect the environment from air pollution, it is advisable to use the air conditioning as little as possible and only when it is really needed.

explain.short: The air conditioning (climatizzatore) takes power from the engine, so the car uses more fuel. Use it only when you need it.
explain.rule: Use the air conditioning only when really needed: it uses fuel. With a cold engine, do not press the accelerator many times or hard, and do not press it fully when changing gear: drive off gently.
explain.trap: 'il meno possibile' (as little as possible): correct advice, not 'never'.

sceneParams.caption: Air conditioning only when needed

q25140.en: To protect the environment from air pollution, you must press the accelerator pedal several times when the vehicle is cold.

explain.short: Pumping the accelerator on a cold engine only sends in extra fuel that does not burn well. It pollutes more.
explain.rule: Use the air conditioning only when really needed: it uses fuel. With a cold engine, do not press the accelerator many times or hard, and do not press it fully when changing gear: drive off gently.
explain.trap: 'più volte' (several times): pumping the pedal is an old myth.

sceneParams.caption: Do not pump the pedal on a cold engine

q25141.en: To protect the environment from air pollution, you must press the accelerator several times and fully, so that the vehicle quickly reaches its working temperature.

explain.short: Revving hard on a cold engine burns a lot of fuel and harms the engine. The best way to warm up is to drive off gently.
explain.rule: Use the air conditioning only when really needed: it uses fuel. With a cold engine, do not press the accelerator many times or hard, and do not press it fully when changing gear: drive off gently.
explain.trap: 'a fondo' (fully) and 'in fretta' (quickly): it sounds useful but wastes fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Warm up by driving gently, not revving
lines: Revving hard: much fuel and gas
Drive off gently to warm up

q25142.en: To protect the environment from air and noise pollution, when changing gear you must press the accelerator pedal fully.

explain.short: Pressing the accelerator fully when changing gear makes the engine roar: more fuel, more exhaust gas and more noise.
explain.rule: Use the air conditioning only when really needed: it uses fuel. With a cold engine, do not press the accelerator many times or hard, and do not press it fully when changing gear: drive off gently.
explain.trap: 'a fondo' (fully): the opposite of what saves fuel and noise.

sceneParams.caption: Full throttle on gear change: smog + noise
lines: Full throttle: more fuel and noise

q25143.en: To limit fuel consumption, it is better to close the windows when travelling at medium-high speed, because the turbulence inside the passenger area can slow the vehicle down.

explain.short: Open windows at speed let air swirl into the car and act like a brake. The engine needs more fuel to keep the speed.
explain.rule: Anything that adds air resistance or weight raises fuel use: open windows or sunroof at speed, a roof rack, snow on the roof, a trailer. Newer 'Euro' standards pollute less. In a tunnel queue, air recirculation is useful.
explain.trap: 'velocità medio alte' (medium-high speed): at speed, closed windows save fuel.

sceneParams.caption: At speed, close the windows

q25144.en: To limit fuel consumption it is better not to use the roof rack, but to put the luggage inside the vehicle.

explain.short: A roof rack (portapacchi) with luggage catches the air and raises fuel use. Luggage inside the car does not.
explain.rule: Anything that adds air resistance or weight raises fuel use: open windows or sunroof at speed, a roof rack, snow on the roof, a trailer. Newer 'Euro' standards pollute less. In a tunnel queue, air recirculation is useful.
explain.trap: 'non conviene' (it is not a good idea): a roof rack costs fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Luggage inside, not on the roof rack

q25145.en: Travelling with a thick layer of snow on the roof of the vehicle increases fuel consumption.

explain.short: Thick snow on the roof adds weight and air resistance, so the car uses more fuel. It can also fall onto the windscreen or other cars.
explain.rule: Anything that adds air resistance or weight raises fuel use: open windows or sunroof at speed, a roof rack, snow on the roof, a trailer. Newer 'Euro' standards pollute less. In a tunnel queue, air recirculation is useful.
explain.trap: No trap: extra weight always costs fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Snow on the roof = more fuel

q25146.en: Travelling at high speed with the vehicle's sunroof open increases fuel consumption.

explain.short: An open sunroof (tettuccio) at high speed lets air swirl in and acts like a brake, so the engine needs more fuel.
explain.rule: Anything that adds air resistance or weight raises fuel use: open windows or sunroof at speed, a roof rack, snow on the roof, a trailer. Newer 'Euro' standards pollute less. In a tunnel queue, air recirculation is useful.
explain.trap: 'forte velocità' (high speed): that is when an open roof costs most fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Open sunroof at speed = more fuel

q25147.en: In case of a long stop in a tunnel, because a queue of vehicles has formed, it is harmful to health to switch on the air recirculation inside the vehicle.

explain.short: In a tunnel queue the outside air is full of exhaust gas. Air recirculation (ricircolo, re-using the air inside) keeps that gas out, so it is useful, not harmful.
explain.rule: Anything that adds air resistance or weight raises fuel use: open windows or sunroof at speed, a roof rack, snow on the roof, a trailer. Newer 'Euro' standards pollute less. In a tunnel queue, air recirculation is useful.
explain.trap: 'dannoso' (harmful): it is the opposite, recirculation protects you.

sceneParams.caption: Tunnel queue: recirculation protects you
lines: Outside air full of exhaust gas

q25148.en: Vehicles that meet the "Euro 4" anti-pollution standard emit more polluting gas than those approved under the "Euro 0" standard.

explain.short: The 'Euro' standards get stricter as the number goes up. A Euro 4 vehicle pollutes LESS than a Euro 0 one.
explain.rule: Anything that adds air resistance or weight raises fuel use: open windows or sunroof at speed, a roof rack, snow on the roof, a trailer. Newer 'Euro' standards pollute less. In a tunnel queue, air recirculation is useful.
explain.trap: 'maggiore' (more): it is the other way round, a higher Euro number means cleaner.

sceneParams.caption: Higher Euro number = cleaner vehicle

q25149.en: Towing a trailer does not increase fuel consumption.

explain.short: A trailer (rimorchio) adds weight and air resistance. The engine must work harder, so fuel use goes up.
explain.rule: Anything that adds air resistance or weight raises fuel use: open windows or sunroof at speed, a roof rack, snow on the roof, a trailer. Newer 'Euro' standards pollute less. In a tunnel queue, air recirculation is useful.
explain.trap: 'non comporta' (does not cause): wrong, a trailer always costs extra fuel.

sceneParams.caption: A trailer increases fuel use

q25150.en: Driving a vehicle whose engine and exhaust have been modified can lead to heavy fines.

explain.short: A vehicle must stay as it was approved (omologato). Changing the engine or exhaust (marmitta) without approval is illegal and brings heavy fines.
explain.rule: You may not freely modify the engine or the exhaust (marmitta) of a vehicle: it must stay as approved. Driving a vehicle with an illegally modified engine or exhaust brings heavy fines.
explain.trap: 'pesanti sanzioni' (heavy fines): yes, it is a serious offence.

sceneParams.caption: Modified engine or exhaust: heavy fines

keywords.it: modificati il motore e la marmitta

q25151.en: It is allowed to freely modify the engine and the exhaust of a vehicle to reduce air pollution.

explain.short: The engine and exhaust must stay as approved. You cannot change them freely, even with a good reason like less pollution.
explain.rule: You may not freely modify the engine or the exhaust (marmitta) of a vehicle: it must stay as approved. Driving a vehicle with an illegally modified engine or exhaust brings heavy fines.
explain.trap: 'liberamente' (freely) and the good-sounding reason 'per diminuire l'inquinamento': still not allowed.

sceneParams.caption: No free changes to engine or exhaust

q25152.en: It is forbidden to pour the antifreeze from the vehicle's cooling system into the sewer, because it may not be biodegradable.

explain.short: Antifreeze (antigelo) is a chemical that may not break down in nature. It must go to proper collection, not down the drain (fognatura).
explain.rule: Dangerous waste (oil, antifreeze, batteries, repair waste) must never be dumped: it is fined. Give old batteries to the seller, scrap a vehicle at an authorised scrapyard (autodemolitore), empty camper waste only at proper stations.
explain.trap: 'potrebbe non essere biodegradabile' (may not break down naturally): that is why it is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: Antifreeze never down the drain
lines: May not break down in nature
Never pour it in the sewer

q25153.en: Abandoning a car battery on the road or on the ground can cause serious damage to the environment and to the groundwater below.

explain.short: A car battery contains acid and heavy metals (lead). Left on the ground, they leak into the soil and the groundwater (falde acquifere).
explain.rule: Dangerous waste (oil, antifreeze, batteries, repair waste) must never be dumped: it is fined. Give old batteries to the seller, scrap a vehicle at an authorised scrapyard (autodemolitore), empty camper waste only at proper stations.
explain.trap: No trap: an abandoned battery is really dangerous.

sceneParams.caption: Old battery: never leave it on the ground
lines: They leak into soil and water

q25154.en: If you buy a car battery, you can hand in the used one to the seller, who will take it back at no extra cost.

explain.short: When you buy a new battery, the seller takes back the old one free of charge, so it can be recycled safely.
explain.rule: Dangerous waste (oil, antifreeze, batteries, repair waste) must never be dumped: it is fined. Give old batteries to the seller, scrap a vehicle at an authorised scrapyard (autodemolitore), empty camper waste only at proper stations.
explain.trap: 'senza ulteriori costi' (at no extra cost): yes, the take-back is free.

sceneParams.caption: Old battery back to the seller, free
lines: Give the old one to the seller

q25155.en: The owner of a vehicle who wants to scrap it must hand it over to a collection centre for making it safe (authorised scrapyard).

explain.short: A vehicle to scrap (rottamare) has oil, fluids and a battery inside. It must go to an authorised scrapyard (autodemolitore) that removes them safely.
explain.rule: Dangerous waste (oil, antifreeze, batteries, repair waste) must never be dumped: it is fined. Give old batteries to the seller, scrap a vehicle at an authorised scrapyard (autodemolitore), empty camper waste only at proper stations.
explain.trap: No trap: an authorised collection centre is the right place.

sceneParams.caption: Scrap the car at an authorised scrapyard

q25156.en: When disposing of engine oil, you must avoid it touching the skin for a long time.

explain.short: Used engine oil contains harmful substances. Long contact with the skin can hurt your health, so use gloves.
explain.rule: Dangerous waste (oil, antifreeze, batteries, repair waste) must never be dumped: it is fined. Give old batteries to the seller, scrap a vehicle at an authorised scrapyard (autodemolitore), empty camper waste only at proper stations.
explain.trap: 'per un tempo prolungato' (for a long time): long contact is the risk.

sceneParams.caption: Used oil: keep it off your skin
lines: Use gloves, take it to collection

q25157.en: Organic waste and dirty water from motor caravans must be emptied at the proper sanitary disposal facilities.

explain.short: Campers (autocaravan) collect toilet waste and dirty water. They must be emptied only at special disposal stations, never on the ground or road.
explain.rule: Dangerous waste (oil, antifreeze, batteries, repair waste) must never be dumped: it is fined. Give old batteries to the seller, scrap a vehicle at an authorised scrapyard (autodemolitore), empty camper waste only at proper stations.
explain.trap: 'appositi impianti' (proper facilities): only there, nowhere else.

sceneParams.caption: Camper waste: only at disposal stations
lines: Never on the ground or road

q25158.en: Leaving dangerous or toxic waste (oils, liquids, repair or replacement leftovers) on the ground is not punished.

explain.short: Dumping dangerous waste pollutes soil and water and is punished by law.
explain.rule: Dangerous waste (oil, antifreeze, batteries, repair waste) must never be dumped: it is fined. Give old batteries to the seller, scrap a vehicle at an authorised scrapyard (autodemolitore), empty camper waste only at proper stations.
explain.trap: 'non viene sanzionato' (is not punished): wrong, it is punished.

sceneParams.caption: Dumping toxic waste IS punished

q25159.en: To scrap a vehicle, you must hand it over only to the car maker's dealer.

explain.short: You can give the vehicle to an authorised scrapyard or collection centre. A dealer can take it too, but not ONLY the maker's dealer.
explain.rule: Dangerous waste (oil, antifreeze, batteries, repair waste) must never be dumped: it is fined. Give old batteries to the seller, scrap a vehicle at an authorised scrapyard (autodemolitore), empty camper waste only at proper stations.
explain.trap: 'esclusivamente' (only): the word that makes it false.

sceneParams.caption: Scrap at authorised centres, not only dealers

q25160.en: It is forbidden to damage road works and installations.

explain.short: Road works and installations (opere e impianti stradali: signs, barriers, lights) keep everyone safe. Damaging them is forbidden.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to damage road works and equipment, throw things or rubbish from vehicles, dirty the road with rubbish, or enter the road with muddy wheels. It is NOT forbidden on all roads to practise driving, use the horn, drive vehicles over 10 m long, or park in residential zones.
explain.trap: No trap: protecting road equipment is a basic rule.

sceneParams.caption: Never damage road equipment

q25161.en: It is forbidden to throw objects and rubbish from moving vehicles.

explain.short: Things thrown from a car can hit other road users and dirty the road. It is forbidden.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to damage road works and equipment, throw things or rubbish from vehicles, dirty the road with rubbish, or enter the road with muddy wheels. It is NOT forbidden on all roads to practise driving, use the horn, drive vehicles over 10 m long, or park in residential zones.
explain.trap: No trap: never throw anything out of the car.

sceneParams.caption: Never throw things from the car
lines: Danger and dirt on the road

q25162.en: It is forbidden to dirty the carriageway by leaving rubbish.

explain.short: Rubbish on the road (carreggiata, the part where vehicles drive) is dirty and dangerous. Leaving it there is forbidden.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to damage road works and equipment, throw things or rubbish from vehicles, dirty the road with rubbish, or enter the road with muddy wheels. It is NOT forbidden on all roads to practise driving, use the horn, drive vehicles over 10 m long, or park in residential zones.
explain.trap: No trap: the road must stay clean.

sceneParams.caption: Never leave rubbish on the road

q25163.en: It is forbidden to enter roads with the vehicle's wheels dirty with mud.

explain.short: Muddy wheels leave mud on the road, and mud makes it slippery for others. You must clean the wheels before entering the road.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to damage road works and equipment, throw things or rubbish from vehicles, dirty the road with rubbish, or enter the road with muddy wheels. It is NOT forbidden on all roads to practise driving, use the horn, drive vehicles over 10 m long, or park in residential zones.
explain.trap: No trap: mud on the asphalt is a danger.

sceneParams.caption: Clean muddy wheels before the road
lines: Muddy wheels from a field or site

q25164.en: On all roads it is forbidden to practise driving.

explain.short: Learners can practise driving on normal roads, with an instructor or a qualified person beside them. It is forbidden only on some roads, such as motorways.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to damage road works and equipment, throw things or rubbish from vehicles, dirty the road with rubbish, or enter the road with muddy wheels. It is NOT forbidden on all roads to practise driving, use the horn, drive vehicles over 10 m long, or park in residential zones.
explain.trap: 'Su tutte le strade' (on all roads): too absolute, so it is false.

sceneParams.caption: Practice is allowed on most roads

q25165.en: On all roads, sound warning devices (horns, trumpets) are forbidden.

explain.short: The horn (clacson) must be used little and only when needed. In built-up areas it is limited to danger, but it is not banned on all roads.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to damage road works and equipment, throw things or rubbish from vehicles, dirty the road with rubbish, or enter the road with muddy wheels. It is NOT forbidden on all roads to practise driving, use the horn, drive vehicles over 10 m long, or park in residential zones.
explain.trap: 'Su tutte le strade' (on all roads): too absolute, the horn is allowed when needed.

sceneParams.caption: The horn is not banned everywhere
lines: Horn: use little, only if needed

q25166.en: On all roads, vehicles longer than 10 m are forbidden.

explain.short: Long vehicles like buses and lorries drive on normal roads. A sign can ban them on a specific road, but not on all roads.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to damage road works and equipment, throw things or rubbish from vehicles, dirty the road with rubbish, or enter the road with muddy wheels. It is NOT forbidden on all roads to practise driving, use the horn, drive vehicles over 10 m long, or park in residential zones.
explain.trap: 'Su tutte le strade' (on all roads): too absolute; bans are only where a sign says so.

sceneParams.caption: Long vehicles: banned only where signed
lines: Banned only where a sign says

q25167.en: It is forbidden to park in residential zones.

explain.short: In residential zones (zone residenziali, quiet streets where people live) you drive slowly and park only in the marked spaces. Parking is not totally forbidden.
explain.rule: It is forbidden to damage road works and equipment, throw things or rubbish from vehicles, dirty the road with rubbish, or enter the road with muddy wheels. It is NOT forbidden on all roads to practise driving, use the horn, drive vehicles over 10 m long, or park in residential zones.
explain.trap: 'E' vietato parcheggiare' with no limit: too strong, parking in proper places is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Residential zone: park in the marked spaces
